correctness.rationale: There are 8!/(2!)⁴=2520 indexed words, and the empty and unit-letter observations are constant. A local abba↔baab exchange preserves every injective scattered count: each block has two copies of each of a,b and two occurrences each of ab and ba, and splitting an injective occurrence by the concatenation boundaries shows preservation in any context. Distinct valid exchange blocks cannot share a letter, because the same two positions of that letter would have to be the same role in both blocks (endpoint distance three, or middle distance one), which fixes the block interval. Overlap of intervals would share a letter. An exchange also cannot create another overlapping block, since the exchanged block remains exchangeable and uses the same positions. Thus the switches are independent, with dimension at most two. There are 5·6·6=180 undirected edges by interval start, exchanged pair and complementary letters' ordering. Dimension two forces two consecutive blocks, giving six ordered choices of first pair. Vertex and edge counts give 156 single edges and 2184 isolated vertices. Independently, I generated the words by choosing two positions for each of three successive letters and assigning the rest to the fourth. For each word I grouped the 16 ways of choosing one indexed occurrence of each letter by the permutation they form. These full-length counts determine every shorter injective count: its sum over compatible full permutations counts each of its occurrences 2^(4−length) times. The independent census recovered exactly 2346 fibers, histogram {1:2184,2:156,4:6}, and compared each fiber directly with the cube of switches of its least member. It reproduced all six minimum representatives of the quartets. One word per fiber is necessary and sufficient for the exact 2346-codeword zero-error maximum.
residual_risks: The direct fiber comparison is exact for the fixed quaternary layer only, and proves no general completeness of Rule SE.

value.rationale: The layer is not an arbitrary small slice: two occurrences per letter is the first uniform multiplicity where the known elementary exchange can operate, and four letters is the first alphabet size beyond the cited ternary setting. The result shows all ambiguity in this natural layer is generated by those exchanges, despite incompleteness in other settings. The breakdown into independent cubes and the exact zero-error selection size are reusable benchmarks beyond raw pair enumeration.
residual_risks: This is a finite classification with no claimed extension to more letters, higher uniform multiplicity or arbitrary content.
